records.subject: Welcome aboard, River Collective
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Active signals: first project reached 7/05, 1 invite sent, and Isla filed a ticket (tick_c1cf6ecf0f78, now closed per email:204c855c), so she's engaged. But key milestone untouched in 6 days despite two nudges (email:656b54b3, email:908b055e), with 8 days left on Starter and a bug that may have slowed her.

draft.subject: Next step for your River Collective workspace
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Glad the notification badge issue is sorted — thanks for flagging it, and the ticket is closed on our side. Shout if it reappears.

You've got your first project set up and an invite out, which is a good start. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next bit of value usually comes from getting real work into that project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything on how your team should be set up.

Best,
Nadia
